newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia takes delivery of British Tornado aircraft.
- Yemeni president opens the first phase of an oil production project in Shabwa region.
- OPEC president says next meeting will concentrate on adhering to quotas and stabilising the oil market.
- Jordan gets a $125 million European loan to help finance economic reforms.
- An international consortium of banks lends Emirates airline $126 million to finance purchase of a Boeing 777 plane.
- Around 600 international investors will take part in the Middle East and North Africa economic summit in Cairo in November.
- International funds invest $25 million in Jordanian bourse.
- Saudi businessmen to offer joint mining projects at the Saudi-Australian committee meeting.
